critical_findings.tfidf_174k_production_baseline_frozen: All 8 TF-IDF representations evaluated at 173,963 decisions on frozen harness v3. All PASS both adversarial gates (language_dominance < 0.85, jurist_pairwise > 0.5). Best production default: cited_decisions_tfidf_outcome_hybrid_0.5 (LangDom=0.4895, JP=0.7265). Fundamental two-mode tradeoff persists: citation-based modes dominate jurist preference; text-based modes fail adversarial language dominance ~0.999.
critical_findings.dense_embedding_acceptance_criteria_vali: Against 22-year/144k legal-distance evidence: (1) Citation heritage AUC 0.79-0.79 (center_projected 64/768/128dim) PASS > 0.75 threshold — dense embeddings EXCEL at citation heritage recovery vs TF-IDF citation-based (AUC 0.71-0.74). (2) Section cross-lingual: sachverhalt cross_lang_same_branch 0.282 PASS > 0.2 threshold; dispositiv 0.148 PASS > 0.1 threshold; erwaegungen 0.093 below. Confirms Sachverhalt > Dispositiv > Erwaegungen hierarchy. (3) Adversarial: center_projected FAILS jurist gate at 144k (JP 0.39-0.42) — does NOT meet jurist preference baseline. (4) Cross-language retrieval recall@10 ~0.04-0.11 FAIL (threshold 0.2). Dense embeddings are COMPLEMENTARY VIEWS ONLY.
critical_findings.v17b_label_normalization_174k: Tested on 15k subsample (213->111 labels). Purity ratios 5x-10x but NMI decreases on normalized labels. Different regime from v17b 1K scale. Normalization merges labels embeddings were separating. Does NOT generalize in same-magnitude sense.
critical_findings.v18_coarse_hierarchy_negative: Even at 4-label branch level: best purity 0.65 (linear_citation_concat) < 0.7 threshold. NMI ~0.004-0.30. Fundamental hierarchy limitation confirmed for TF-IDF/citation representations.
